turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mr. Sharma from Pune? I am Inspector Vikram Singh from the Cyber Crime Cell.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma. Is there some problem? Why are you calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we have intercepted a narcotics parcel sent to your address and your Aadhaar is linked to the sender. This is a serious criminal offense.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What narcotics? I have never sent any such parcel in my life, there must be a mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we need to verify your identity. You are now under digital arrest, so do not hang up or tell anyone, otherwise we will send a team to arrest you immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Digital arrest? I don't understand. Can I speak to my son or come to the station?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, you are not allowed to contact anyone until this is cleared. If you cooperate, we can settle this through a security verification process.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very worried now. Please tell me what I have to do to clear my name.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must transfer fifty thousand rupees to our government verification account. Once the audit is done, the money will be refunded and the case closed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fifty thousand is a lot of money for me. Are you sure this is the only way?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, it is either this amount or a jail term. Send the money now or I will have to issue the warrant for your home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, okay, please don't do that. I will try to arrange it from my savings.
